actions.observed: Options are stored-only; explicit detail GET preserves hidden traits, saves observation and restores focus on Escape.
Real local read handler reports fake upstream failure, retains the map and succeeds on explicit retry.
Separate explicit market and shipyard reads update rendered stored data without gameplay writes.
Map handoff preselects ship and target; docked travel explains orbit. Preview, cancel and Stop perform no gameplay writes.
Separate orbit and travel approvals execute through the real fixture queue. Destination/reserve survive; returned transit stays unconfirmed until explicit upstream refresh.
Server rejects unsafe fuel continuation before approval with a visible error and zero gameplay writes.
Expired approval reports server rejection without a write.
Stop prevents queued transport; a lost write response shows uncertainty and blocks new commands. Explicit reconciliation performs reads without replay.
Explicit fuel/time thresholds require acknowledgement, appear in existing server preview and remain separate from approval.
No-sensor, wrong-location charting and cooldown states explain unavailable actions.
Guarded exploration preview/approval/queue performs one scan, applies cooldown and displays normalized revealed traits on the original map location.
A scan that returns no target leaves traits unknown and stops after one write.
Current uncharted location is charted through separate approval and queue execution; the map displays the returned traits.
Map context does not take over unrelated command cancellation or reopen on browser Back to ship.
Browser Back restores the selected map card, and blank reserve retains the configured floor rather than silently becoming zero.
360px phone uses scrollable modal, readable controls and no horizontal page overflow.

scope: Real local UI and Laravel handlers with owned FakeSpaceTraders transport and bounded database queue. No new live API tests.
